anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential over-utilization or bottlenecks.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, which might suggest it is not functioning as intended.
Trading system shows zero active trades and zero profit/loss, which could indicate inactivity or issues with trade execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review and potentially enhance AI algorithms to ensure they are actively learning and generating opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies and system configurations to ensure they are actively seeking and executing trades.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve any bottlenecks or inefficiencies.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to degraded system performance, affecting trading operations and user experience.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to determine why it is not generating learning cycles or opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity could result in missed trading opportunities and reduced platform competitiveness.

recommendations.action: Assess the trading system's configurations and strategies to ensure they are correctly set up and actively seeking trades.
recommendations.rationale: Zero active trades and P/L could indicate configuration issues or lack of market engagement.
